title: Dev9 read-only usage and provider-reported financial evidence
summary: Cloud Economics dev9 adds deterministic evidence correlation of case/job/lease/execution period/currency, an explicit unmanaged like-for-like baseline, exact-decimal metered usage and caller-reported provider charge lines. The resulting delta is never an authenticated provider invoice or realized savings.
invariants: All inputs are FIXTURE or UNVERIFIED; no source authenticity or financial settlement is asserted.
case/job/lease/start/end/currency scope must match exactly for every observation.
Invoice line identity is unique and cannot be billed twice under another local evidence ID.
Missing usage, incomplete charge lines, ESTIMATED charges or missing baseline yield INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE and no delta.
A completed set of caller-reported INVOICED lines yields UNVERIFIED_COUNTERFACTUAL_DELTA only.
realized_savings is always null and external_source_verified=false.
Local SHA-256 chain is non-authoritative tamper evidence; a malicious actor can rewrite or truncate local history.
No cross-currency conversion, adjustments, credits, taxes, provider authentication, cloud provisioning, migration or Accounting Core posting is implemented.
procedure: Ingest exact JSONL under the documented schema with a unique evidence ID and caller-supplied source digest.
Run reconcile-audit to verify the local journal chain before rendering any report.
Require like-for-like unmanaged baseline, observed usage, expected number of INVOICED charge lines, and identical execution scope.
Emit evidence IDs, count, reported charges and, only if complete, the unverified counterfactual difference.
Escalate provider attestation, invoice adjustments, accounting treatment, IAM and transport to their authoritative owners.

provenance.claim: Source-qualified read-only observer; not provider authenticated.
